meta.name: google-ads-copy
meta.description: Generate and A/B test Google Ads copy. Use when asked to write ad copy, headlines, descriptions, create ad variants, test ad messaging, improve CTR, or generate RSA (Responsive Search Ad) components. Trigger on "ad copy", "write ads", "headlines", "descriptions", "RSA", "responsive search ad", "ad text", "ad creative", "improve CTR", "ad A/B test", "ad variants", "write me an ad", "ad variation experiment", or when the user wants to improve click-through rate on existing ads.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成并A/B测试谷歌广告文案，提升点击率
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速创建和优化谷歌搜索广告文案。
copy.tagline_en: Generate and A/B test Google Ads copy to boost CTR.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create and optimize Google Search ad copy.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的业务背景生成 Google 广告文案，并帮你做 A/B 测试来找出效果最好的版本。
howto.when: 当你提到“广告文案”、“写广告”、“标题”、“描述”、“RSA”等关键词，或者要求提高点击率、测试广告变体时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一组 Google 搜索广告的标题和描述。
say.note: Claude 会要求提供业务背景，然后生成 RSA 组件。

say.text: 为我的广告组创建两个不同角度的变体进行 A/B 测试。
say.note: Claude 会使用实验框架创建变体并监控效果。

say.text: 分析现有广告的点击率，并建议改进方案。
say.note: Claude 会拉取当前广告数据，基于转化率提出优化建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate Google Ads copy based on your business context and help you run A/B tests to find the best-performing version.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "ad copy", "write ads", "headlines", "descriptions", "RSA", or ask to improve CTR or test ad variants.

say_en.text: Write a set of Google Search ad headlines and descriptions for me.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for business context, then generate RSA components.

say_en.text: Create two different-angle variants for my ad group to A/B test.
Analyze the CTR of my existing ads and suggest improvements.
